decision.missing: A decision is needed: Confirmed or Dismissed.
decision.unknown: “{{value}}” is not a decision. Use Confirmed or Dismissed.
decision.copies-not-confirmed: These files are copies by their bytes or registry ids, which no one has to confirm: keep them as they are, or remove a copy.
decision.one-file-not-decided: These are names of one file, not copies of it: removing a name frees nothing, so there is nothing to keep or remove.
decision.unreadable-body: The body must be JSON with a decision, such as { "decision": "Confirmed" }.

removal.unreadable-body: The body must be JSON with the group and the file, such as { "groupKey": "<key>", "fileId": "<id>" }.
removal.request-incomplete: Remove needs the group and the file you pressed it on.
removal.page-changed: This copy changed since the page showed it. Reload the page to see it as it is now.
removal.unsupported: The app can't rename files on the platform it runs on, so nothing was removed.
removal.no-other-copy-on-disk: No other copy of this group is on the disk as the app last read it, so this one stays. Inspect the library's files again to see what is there.
removal.busy: This removal is being worked on right now. Try again in a moment.
removal.changed-meanwhile: This removal changed while the app was working on it, so it stopped. Reload the page to see where it stands.
removal.switched-off-midway: Replacing and removing copies was switched off on the Media folders page.

restore.nothing: Nothing of this removal is in the quarantine, so there's nothing to put back.
restore.switched-off: Replacing and removing copies is switched off on the Media folders page, so nothing can be put back. Turn on “Replace copies after verification”, then press Restore again.
restore.video-deleted: This copy's video was deleted permanently, so nothing is put back without it. Delete permanently what the quarantine still holds.

delete.nothing: This removal holds nothing in the quarantine to delete.
delete.switched-off: Replacing and removing copies is switched off on the Media folders page, so nothing can be deleted. Turn on “Replace copies after verification”, then press Delete permanently again.

rule.not-removable-class: Only a copy in “Exact copies” or “Same film, different files” can be removed.
rule.switched-off: Removing copies is switched off. Turn on “Replace copies after verification” under Media folders.
rule.outside-media-folders: This file isn't inside the Media folders, so the app can't move it.
rule.not-ticked: This file's library folder isn't ticked for replacement under Media folders.
rule.not-inspected: The app hasn't inspected this file yet. Press Inspect files on the Library page first.
rule.not-readable: The app's last look couldn't read this file as media, so it can't tell what would go.
rule.disc-clip: This file is part of a disc folder, which can't be removed one file at a time.
rule.other-work: This file also holds a film or an episode outside this group, which would go with it.
rule.held-by-replacement: A replacement on the Jobs page holds this file.
rule.held-by-removal: A removal under Removed copies holds this file.
rule.last-readable-copy: No other copy in this group is one the app has read as media, so this one stays: it may be the only one that plays.

list.unknown-class: “{{value}}” is not a duplicate class. Use SameFile, ByteIdentical, SameWork or Possible.
list.unknown-sort: “{{value}}” is not a sort. Use Default or Recoverable.

list.listed_one: {{count, number}} duplicate group in all; page {{page, number}} lists {{listed, number}}.
list.listed_other: {{count, number}} duplicate groups in all; page {{page, number}} lists {{listed, number}}.
